prompt:
You are a equity research analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-05-14, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock.
Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-05-14):
| Return 3m            | -3.3% |
| Return 1m            | +0.9% |
| Return 1w            | +2.2% |
| Range position (63d) | 50% |
| 21d realized vol     | 19% |
| Last close           | 62.97 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock has mixed short-term momentum—positive over the last week and month, but negative over the last three months—suggesting no clear directional breakout. With a neutral position in its trading range (50%) and modest volatility, there is no strong evidence of a sustained move over the next ~20 trading days. Therefore, a cautious stance is warranted.

DECISION: HOLD
